name: doyled-it-skills
description: Michael Doyle's personal Claude Code skills.

plugins.name: nonfiction-superpowers
plugins.description: A superpowers-style workflow for nonfiction prose: brainstorm, design, research, draft, review, and edit, as a sequence of composable skills (orchestrated by writing-nonfiction). Includes the structure/data rules and the AI-slop blacklist.

plugins.name: codegraph
plugins.description: Understand code through CodeGraph: initialize missing indexes, sync before querying, respect explicit indexing restrictions, and inspect unsupported files directly. Start with using-codegraph.

plugins.name: cross-repo-completeness
plugins.description: Map and verify a change's full surface across a multi-repo system so a change does not ship wired in one repo and missing in the others. Start with the cross-repo-completeness skill. Pairs with codegraph (its per-repo engine).

plugins.name: development-loop
plugins.description: A disciplined development loop for any feature or bugfix, single-repo or multi-repo: ground understanding in codegraph, compose the superpowers phases (brainstorm, plan, TDD, finish), and verify the full cross-repo surface. Start with the development-loop skill.
